params.prompt: Bold, simple, instantly readable mobile app ad visual, 4:5 vertical. Solid saturated flat background with subtle radial glow, nothing else in the scene. The hero group sits in the center (35%-82% height). Upper 30% of frame completely empty, bottom 15% completely empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people except the mascot, no money. Clean premium 3D render. Include the cute 3D mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M), drawn SMALL (about 25% of the hero group height) as a supporting accent, not the main subject. Hero object: a glossy 3D balance scale; the left pan is weighed down holding a tall stack of white shield tokens (representing peers), the right pan is raised holding only one small red shield token; a big red notification badge with a question mark symbol floats above the right pan. Meri sits on the raised right pan looking at the other side, puzzled face. Background: vivid warm orange.
